title: orchis coriophora subsp. cimicina
intro: Orchis coriophora subsp. cimicina, commonly known as the Cimon Orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health conditions, including inflammation and digestive issues. The Cimon Orchid is believed to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its health benefits. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
